dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.purpose: Pause the process for a required decision, confirmation, review, or focused form.

anatomy.rule: Centers the decision with Design System radius, spacing, border, and elevation.
Expose primary and safe secondary outcomes.

Energy.decision: Use semantic surfaces and action color for contrast.
Energy.test: Verify contrast on panel and actions.
Energy.rejectIf: Raw color defines panel or action.

Voice.behavior: The user understands the decision before acting.
Voice.test: Verify title and description are direct.

Frame.decision: Use Design System spacing, width, radius, and action layout.

Depth.decision: Use overlay and elevation to block background task.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System enter and exit motion.
Momentum.rejectIf: Raw duration or easing is used.

State.behavior: Controls match open, focus, closing, default, and closed.

Tone.decision: Use tone to match risk and action wording.
Tone.behavior: Danger moments are explicit but not alarmist.

Growth.decision: Use Dialog only when escalation from inline feedback is required.
Growth.example: Toast escalates to Dialog for destructive confirmation.
Growth.rejectIf: Dialog is used for passive feedback.

Symbol.test: Verify icon is not the only signal.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizes and alignment.

Accessibility.decision: Use modal semantics, focus management, keyboard close, and restored focus.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard and screen-reader users stay oriented.

dont: Do not use for passive feedback.
info: Use Drawer or Toast when the task can continue.

agentInstructions: Ask before allowing overlay dismissal on risky actions.
Define focus, Escape, close, and reduced-motion behavior.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when local open state changes.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Called when an action is selected.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Decision job: confirmation, destructive, form, review, or success.

props.name: state
props.notes: Lifecycle state: open, focus, closing, default, or closed.

props.name: density
props.notes: Inherited Density scale for trigger, close, actions, panel, and fields.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Optional Material Symbol override for the tone icon.

props.name: fields
props.notes: Optional short form fields rendered with Input inside the dialog body.
